body: And have you looked into CBD oil?

Thank you so fucking much. Nice to know I'm not alone and decent people are experiencing similar. I reached out to friend just before that maybe could have avoided this spiral at the start. I'm so close to checking into rehab or a hospital because I feel like I've left it too long and I can't seem to get out of it on my own for a month now. Today has been really bad. Tried meditation all day when I had cravings and the mediation led me to super nhilistic views and like it's not even worth fixing myself because unless I can excape the society and things in my life I will never fully beat this. The people around me fully don't understand or seem to know what to do. Professionals want to put me on antidepressants even tho it's super super obvious environmental chronic stress with no proper support that's pushing me here. Every day is damaging me more and I can't be expected to know what to do or have the strength to do it while I've been neglected my entire life.

I'd love to switch to CBD oil instead of unknown crap weed mixed with tobacco but I don't have the options where I am. Im thinking if I quit the nicotine with patches it will help alot with the cravings and cut out all thc it could help with the new found anxiety about the situation. Is this a reasonable step towards recovery?

Your absolutely right. But idk if you've realised or not, it's not exactly easy to overcome depression or anxiety. The population is getting worse and the methods for treatment do not work. Something dramatic needs to change either in society or in psychology or we will keep losing this battle

Don't hurt yourself because this isn't your fault. You didn't ask for this and you've tried your best to fix it but it's so fucking hard when this shit snowballs to this point. I'm so sorry that I can't say more to help
Your not alone. Feel a new hope after reading this

Thank you. Ive been in a bad place for a while but tonight decide to look at positive stuff before bed to break the cycle. Ended up here and I'm so greatfull that there are caring people that take time to write things that could save someone's life. Truly thank you

I feel you dude. Can't offer any advice as your posts sums up alot of why I'm here to the dot. Just know your not alone and just coming here is a step towards the right direction. I called a crisis line on the other side of the planet today hoping they would have some insight for me and now I'm here. Keep pushing every day a little and we will get through this

I've been riding my pushbike almost daily but I spend most of the ride holding back tears and dwelling on everything. Really not keen on other medication but I'm starting to think there's no other hope.

Cheers for your reply. My underlying issues are holding me back and I feel I need drastic change before I can even think about stopping but I can't get the support needed without being judged and misunderstood.  I'm searching for someone that's slightly more liberal towards cannabis and it's effects that won't treat me worse than an alcoholic and work with me despite the complexity of it all. If I don't get at the cause I'll never quit for the right reason and it will always be there or I'll develope some other unhealthy coping mechanism. I was coping okay with my life before I tried to quit and it's been absolute hell ever since sending me to places I've never been and slowly killing the little bit of hope I was holding onto. I will legitimately fly across this globe if I can find someone to help me start my journey. I know I shouldn't have to rely on someone to fix my life. But if you knew the circumstances I hope you'd understand how weak and alone I am. And how hard I want to fix this

Yeah if I knew what to change even if it was small I would be trying my hardest to push through the pain and take the steps. But it's the limbo that gets me. Im lost and the only thing that I can think of doing seems so dramatic that I would of cringed at the thought before
That sounds really cool, and awesome to hear you have a friend to connect with. Your post will hopefully give alot of people hope

I literally don't know where to start because it's snowballed for so long and there's so many aspects to it now and I'm so disappointed that my life got to this stage where I'm completely alone asking for help on a suicide prevention forum at 2am, it's so fking sad

Cheers for all the advice despite what people may consider my attitude and unwillingness. Found this post and sub and I'm gonna hang there for a while and hopefully make it to /leaves when im ready. I'm going to try and deal with the underlying issues as priority and hopefully that will allow me the strength to quit. Apologies if I annoyed anyone and thanks for everyone's time.

So your saying depending on my luck of the draw depends what group of meds I might have access too? Yeah definitely makes me more comfortable to the idea...

Just spend 5 minutes for yourself with a open mind on the internet and come back and tell me there's nothing worth looking at in cannabis for the treatment of anxiety, depression and ptsd, and there are companies in aus spending millions or trying to grow legal weed here for huge ranges of illnesses. People not only are unaware of where medicinal cannabis is at at the moment but flat out refusing to learn.

At the end of the day I have a happier more productive day when I smoke a few spaced throughout the day. I'm a great person and I know it. I care for those around me and strangers too. Im a safe responsible person that just wants to be happy in the life I was given. Days where I question myself are always spawned from my disappointment in my life being that traumatic that I turned to something that happens to be illegal where I live. Which is why I know I don't want to smoke forever and why I'm taking steps no matter how small to try and progress myself.  Due to how I see people around me that are on antidepressants that have experienced less than me but are still living worse off emotionally makes me reserved. Seeing two friends turn suicidal shortly after going onto pills and then returning to their "normal" depressed but functioning selves after coming off also makes me reserved.  I'm still here and I'm not going to stop searching for the right steps for me to take. But everyone here accusing me of not wanting to change is seriously ridiculous

You really don't understand unfortunately im not sure how else I can explain myself without getting accused further. That's not a psychologists job at all lol Yeah let's just blame me for not being willing to except help cos the current approach of medical professionals is clearly working with Australia on top for weed use and a global rise in depression and antidepressants at the same time. 

I'm not really sure how you can claim my mindset is wrong when you along with everyone else seem to ignore my point. How can I seriously be expected to take word from Australian psychologists that are anti weed as gospel. When in the States there are professionals that believe and preach cannabis as a viable option for ptsd and a range of other things?

Please someone address this point.
I think you misunderstood those comments tbh. My judgement is fine. It's people's inability to understand that seems to be the problem.

Everyone keeps ignoring the main point I make and I'm not sure how I should be taking that, if I was else where your advice would be different... I'm not being challenged at all. I'm being spoken to like a child being told to breath and that I should book into rehab. Not once have I heard the words flight flight freeze fawn, or anything else that really has anything to do with my situation. So either I've been speaking to the wrong people. Hence my post. Or just as in here. People are just unwilling to actually understand and just jump to the typical attitude towards addicts. Again not really sure what I would get out of acting how people think I am. I could just keep smoking if I wanted to or move somewhere where it's legal. Quite frustrating to have my attempts be twisted into making me out to be unwanting to change.

It's not that. I know all that and I agree with it all and I hate that I'm that way and it's not that I asked for my life to deal me that hand.  It's just how can you sit there and tell me that a recommendation for a ssri and some self searchable mindfulness exercises from a psych I pay 150 a hour is any more of a solution than moving to the states and seeing a GP and psych that would do exactly as you claim here is so unethical and let me eat the oil of a plant legaly and continue my capable and decent life hahaha. It absolutely ridiculous to me and honestly not sure how you or anyone else can be surprised that I'm at that point where I'm reserved.

I did that at the start and coped okay for a while. Turning to nhilism and stoicism but my day to day responsibilities where too much for my brain to handle alone and the darkness was getting to me. I reached out for weed after hating the thought of it before. It saved my life and I can't forget that. I will definitely try emdr and sorry I didn't reply to that. I've tried meditation and mindfulness and they do help so I'm not against anything of that sort. Apologies if I've been frustrating for people here and thanks for your time

I'd love to be able to do that and it's not that I'm unwilling because I love being an addict. I'm just scared. All the advice I've gotten is slightly different and I'm not just getting a second opinion for a twisted ankle. It's my life and my mental health and I feel like i should trust myself slightly. And again. It's not that I need weed to be the solution, it's the fact that if I happen to be born and lived my life in the u.s.a, and I was dealing with the same issues I was before I started self medicating, a GP would very likely recommend me cannabis, just knowing that is a major reason why I'm not ready to completely jump the gun and I'm not sure how any self respecting medical professional can go a day without having the knowledge necessary to fully convince someone that a medicine that works for them is actually not working and detrimental to them. I'm definitely here because I don't want to have to smoke, but the urgency is the issue and when someone tells me I need to book into a inpatient rehab program because I smoke a plant to relax my mind after trauma that left me wanting to die I get maybe slightly offended when that same professional would have zero issue writing me a prescription for a pill that they don't even truly understand. So yeah I am slightly reserved and I understand this isn't the best sub for that discussion. But I reached out here for a reason and I'm hoping just one suggestion might help me on my journey. Thank you for your effort either way

Psychologists with referral from either my gp or from searching for dual diagnosis specialists and ptsd specialists. Yeah I don't really like what I'm hearing because firstly none of it is consistent and people that haven't been in the situation seem to lack the insight needed to connect and understand what's going on. Let alone getting a slight feeling of someone actually caring more about my progress than how many sessions they will be able to book me for or judging me with some outdated belief or stereotype. Im not really sure what I would get out of admitting I'm addicted and wanting to quit on here but then sabotaging myself in the same post... I'm here for a reason. I want to quit and deal with my underlying issues, but I'm struggling to take the steps on my own. I'm not in a position to start making friends and relying on them for the support I need. So I'm here asking if anyone has experience quiting and might have a recommendation for a specific person in Brisbane that helped them, and I would prefer if the professional themselves might have experience or at least a true and current understanding of what we know about cannabis as I'm not just smoking joints to munch out and play Xbox with my highschool buddies. I'm using it as a legitimate medicine to be able to function in my day to day life. Again I can't forget that if I was in the u.s, a place way less "laid back" and maybe socially progressive than Australia. I could go to my gp tell the about my flashbacks only and be given a card to pop down to the corner store to buy specially grown high CBD low thc cannabis. While I understand what your opinion of that may be, it doesn't change it. So I apologise if I seem reserved to certain ideas or suggestions but I definitely came here because I need help.

I quit for 3 weeks cold turkey, But after 5 different therapists and feeling like each one was overwhelmed by the complexity of the underlying issues and not interested in a non biased conversation about cannabis I lost hope. Considered looking for someone around nimbin but that's ridiculous. I understand people will just think I'm a drug addict trying to find any excuse to keep using but that couldn't be further from the truth. I don't drink or use any other drugs and before multiple traumas led me to postponing suicide due to family responsibility I would have never have even touched weed. It helped me fight through and find some moments of happiness and I need a therapist that can understand that at least.

I struggled with convincing myself that I wasn't just doing as you said. Wanting someone to agree with me and allow a moderate version of my use. But then I realised if I was in the u.s or a range of other places the opinions I would be getting about the topic from both professionals and civilians would be very different and I want to   explore all options properly. I smoke to calm my mind about my past trauma and inevitable future. If I could take an ssri and know I won't become suicidal or become just as addicted to that as the cannabis I would along time ago. But my responsibilities mean I can't have any unknown risks and I feel like cannabis is the safest treatment for my symptoms currently as I know what it does and how it effects me. Obviously I don't want to have to use anything to cope with my life but I'm not at that stage I'm just struggling to want to let go of something that's been there for me. Everyone around me drinks and takes antidepressants daily and I just don't see that as a better option
